更新安装助手不可用。: The update installation helper is unavailable.
更新助手在复制期间发生变化。: The update helper changed while being copied.

更新助手校验失败，尚未退出应用。: The update helper failed verification. The application has not quit.
更新助手返回异常。: The update helper returned an unexpected response.
更新状态与当前应用不匹配。: The update state does not match the current application.

请选择项目内的文件夹。: Choose a folder inside the project.
请选择具体项目内的文件夹。: Choose a folder inside a specific project.
此文件夹不参与文档浏览。: This folder is excluded from document browsing.
文件夹不能是符号链接或指向项目外部。: The folder cannot be a symbolic link or point outside the project.
更新准备已取消，文档保持原样。你可以重试安装。: Update preparation was canceled. Your documents are unchanged. You can retry the installation.
另一个更新操作正在进行，请稍后重试安装。: Another update operation is in progress. Try installing again in a moment.
请先将 Folio 移到本机可写的应用程序文件夹，再重试安装更新。: Move Folio to a writable applications folder on this Mac, then try installing the update again.
安装包未通过安全校验，原应用保持不变。请重新下载更新；若仍失败，请查看发布页面。: The installation package failed security checks. The original application is unchanged. Download the update again; if it still fails, check the release page.
更新安装助手未能启动或通过检查，原应用保持不变。请重新打开 Folio 后重试；: The update helper could not start or pass its checks. The original application is unchanged. Reopen Folio and try again; if it still fails, install the update manually from the release page.
请先单击内容进入编辑，再插入或设置格式。: Click the content to edit it before inserting or formatting.
选区已变化，请重新选择文字。: The selection has changed. Select the text again.
文档已变化，请重新生成修改建议。: The document has changed. Generate a new suggestion.
登录地址无效，请更新 Codex CLI 后重试。: The sign-in address is invalid. Update Codex CLI and try again.
请登录 ChatGPT，使用你的订阅额度。: Sign in with ChatGPT to use your plan.
请在浏览器完成登录，完成后会自动连接。: Finish signing in in your browser. Folio will connect automatically.
请先停止当前回复，再开始新对话。: Stop the current response before starting a new conversation.
请先连接并登录 ChatGPT。: Connect and sign in with ChatGPT first.
Agent 正在回复，请先等待或停止。: The agent is responding. Wait or stop the response first.
文档或请求过长，请缩小范围后重试。: The document or request is too long. Use a smaller scope and try again.
当前账号没有可用模型，请重新连接。: No models are available for this account. Reconnect and try again.
登录未完成，请重试。: Sign-in did not finish. Try again.
Agent 未能完成回复，请检查连接后重试。: The agent could not finish its response. Check the connection and try again.
修改建议已失效，请重新生成。: This suggestion is no longer available. Generate it again.
尚未找到 Codex，请先安装 Codex CLI，然后重新连接。: Codex was not found. Install Codex CLI, then reconnect.
Codex 未能启动，请检查安装后重新连接。: Codex could not start. Check its installation, then reconnect.
Codex 响应超时，请重新连接后重试。: Codex took too long to respond. Reconnect and try again.
Codex 返回内容过大，请缩小文档范围后重试。: The Codex response was too large. Use a smaller document scope.
Codex 通信格式不兼容，请更新 Codex CLI 后重试。: The Codex protocol is incompatible. Update Codex CLI and try again.
Codex 未能完成请求，请检查登录状态后重试。: Codex could not complete the request. Check your sign-in and try again.
只能添加当前项目中的参考文档。: Reference documents must belong to the current project.
参考文档过大，请选择更小的文档。: This reference is too large. Choose a smaller document.
用你的 ChatGPT 订阅，在文档旁提问、推敲和修改。: Ask, explore, and edit beside your document with your ChatGPT plan.
请在 Folio 桌面应用中连接 Agent。: Connect an agent in the Folio desktop app.
选中文字，或把当前文档交给 Agent。: Select a passage, or work with the current document.
打开对应文档后可审阅修改。: Open the corresponding document to review these changes.
请先在文档中选择文字。: Select some text in the document first.
已应用 Agent 修改，可以撤销或在历史版本中恢复。: Agent changes applied. You can undo them or restore a previous version.
当前订阅额度暂不可用，请稍后重试或检查 ChatGPT 的使用额度。: Your plan usage is currently unavailable. Try later or check your ChatGPT usage limits.
登录已失效，请重新连接并登录 ChatGPT。: Your sign-in has expired. Reconnect and sign in with ChatGPT again.
API 地址需要使用 HTTPS；本机服务可以使用 HTTP。: Use an HTTPS API address. Local services may use HTTP.
请填写 API 地址和模型名称。: Enter the API address and model name.
修改 API 地址时，请重新填写对应的 API Key。: Enter the corresponding API key when changing the API address.
系统安全存储不可用，暂时无法保存 API Key。: System secure storage is unavailable. The API key could not be saved.
请先在 Agent 设置中配置 API。: Configure the API in Agent settings first.
系统安全存储不可用，暂时无法读取 API Key。: System secure storage is unavailable. The API key could not be read.
API Key 无法读取，请在设置中重新填写。: The API key could not be read. Enter it again in settings.
API 返回内容过大，请缩小范围后重试。: The API response was too large. Use a smaller scope and try again.
API 授权失败，请在设置中检查 API Key。: API authorization failed. Check your API key in settings.
API 使用额度或请求频率已达到限制，请稍后重试。: The API usage or request limit was reached. Try again later.
API 请求失败，请检查服务地址或稍后重试。: The API request failed. Check the service address or try again later.
当前 API 不支持这项操作。: This API does not support that operation.
模型列表格式不兼容，请手动填写模型名称。: The model list is incompatible. Enter the model name manually.
API 回复被截断，请缩小范围后重试。: The API response was cut short. Use a smaller scope and try again.
API 回复格式不完整，请重试。: The API response is incomplete. Try again.
API 响应超时，请稍后重试。: The API took too long to respond. Try again later.
请先停止当前回复，再更改 Agent 设置。: Stop the current response before changing Agent settings.
API 接入不需要订阅登录，请在设置中填写凭据。: API connections use the credentials in settings, without subscription sign-in.
选择文档助手的接入方式。文档与改动审阅使用同一个面板。: Choose how to connect your document assistant. Both options use the same document and review panel.
在官方页面登录，使用账号提供的 Codex 额度。: Sign in on the official page to use the Codex access included with your account.
连接支持 Chat Completions 的服务，使用该服务的 API 额度。: Connect a service that supports Chat Completions and use its API allowance.
已保存，留空保持现有 Key: Saved; leave blank to keep the current key
输入 API Key；本机服务可留空: Enter an API key; local services may leave this blank
填写服务提供的模型 ID: Enter the model ID provided by the service
服务检测成功，可从模型列表中选择。: Service check succeeded. You can choose from the model list.
API Key 通过系统安全存储加密。更换服务地址时需重新填写对应的 Key。: API keys are encrypted with system secure storage. Enter the matching key when changing services.
使用已配置的 API，与文档继续对话。: Continue working with your document using the configured API.
断开后暂停自动恢复，登录信息仍保留。: Disconnecting pauses automatic recovery. Your sign-in is kept.
请在 Agent 设置中选择可用的轻量建议模型。: Choose an available lightweight suggestion model in Agent settings.
文档建议暂不可用，可以直接输入你的问题。: Document suggestions are unavailable. You can type your question directly.
建议使用轻量模型生成；留空时不会调用更贵的模型。: Use a lightweight model for suggestions. Leaving this blank will not call a more expensive model.
文档已变化，请重新打开右键菜单。: The document changed. Open the context menu again.
Codex 安装缺少当前 Mac 的原生程序，请重新安装 Codex CLI 后: The native Codex executable for this Mac is missing. Reinstall Codex CLI and connect again.
Codex 启动器未找到 Node，请重新安装 Codex CLI 后连接。: The Codex launcher could not find Node. Reinstall Codex CLI and connect again.
Codex 启动配置不兼容，请更新 Codex CLI 后重试。: This Codex version cannot use the launch configuration. Update Codex CLI and retry.
Codex 在连接完成前退出，请更新 Codex CLI 或导出诊断信息。: Codex exited before connecting. Update Codex CLI or export diagnostics.
Codex 登录回应不完整，请更新 Codex CLI 后重试。: Codex returned an incomplete sign-in response. Update Codex CLI and retry.
浏览器未能打开，请点击打开登录页或复制登录链接。: The browser did not open. Open the sign-in page or copy the sign-in link.
诊断信息仅含运行事件，日志最多约 1 MB；不包含正文、对话或凭据。: Diagnostics contain runtime events only, capped at about 1 MB. Document text, conversations and credentials are excluded.
找到的是桌面应用入口，请安装 Codex CLI 后重新连接。: This entry launches a desktop app. Install Codex CLI and connect again.
复制内容无效或过长。: The text to copy is invalid or too large.
用于阅读模式的 ⌘C。右键菜单始终提供两种格式。: Applies to ⌘C in reading mode. Both formats are always available in the context menu.
关闭窗口或退出时，决定下次是否恢复打开的标签。关闭标签不会删除文档或恢复草稿。: Choose whether to restore open tabs after closing a window or quitting. Closing tabs keeps documents and recovery drafts.
保留标签顺序，并回到当前文档。: Keep tab order and return to the current document.
文档和恢复草稿仍保留在本机。: Documents and recovery drafts stay on this Mac.
请等待当前操作完成，再关闭窗口。: Wait for the current action to finish before closing the window.
{count} 个标签暂时无法恢复，可从最近文档重新打开。: {count} {count|tab is|tabs are} unavailable. You can reopen them from recent documents.
